lead: A bench that subscripts an array with a bare `uint` expression counts two allocations per round that are not the member's.
body: `$keys[$total % 3]` allocated twice per access, where `$keys[($total % 3) as int]` allocated nothing, so a reader's bench declaring `// bench: allocations 0` fails and blames the member. Cast the index with `as int` and bind the element to a typed local, the way `benches/members/core/Ast-Node/offset.nvs` does.
